title: Smoked Salmon Soufflés
description: Fluffy cheat's soufflés using shop-bought fresh custard as the secret ingredient — they rise perfectly every time. A stunning dinner-party starter.
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Grease 6 small ramekins and arrange in a deep baking tray.
Whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Break 80g of the salmon into small pieces in a bowl. Add the custard, mix and leave to infuse for 30 minutes.
Fold the egg whites into the custard mixture a spoonful at a time. Fill the ramekins two-thirds full.
Make a bain-marie by pouring boiling water into the tray to a third of the way up the ramekins.
Bake for 15–18 minutes until risen at least 2.5cm above the rim and golden. Serve immediately, scattered with remaining salmon.
notes: Makes 6 soufflés. Can be made ahead and kept in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat at 240°C for 10 minutes.
